title: pkgutil.find_loader and get_loader are deprecated
summary: Python 3.12 deprecates pkgutil.find_loader() and pkgutil.get_loader(), to be removed in Python 3.14.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-type differences.

steps.title: Use find_spec
steps.instructions: Replace the call with importlib.util.find_spec(name) and read spec.loader if the loader is needed.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
